name: Anhui Tatfook Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Anhui Tatfook Technology Co., Ltd engages in the mobile communication equipment business and other businesses in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers communication RF products, including TM and TE mode high performance dielectric filter; metal, small micro metal, and waveguide filters; amplifier upon the tower; smart combiner; active antenna unit; base station antenna; and dielectric resonator.
